title: The context bar draws its slots from fallback fonts
body:
`context_line` in `src/header.rs` draws the context bar from `FILLED` (`▰`, U+25B0) and `EMPTY` (`▱`, U+25B1). JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, which Jack's ghostty uses, has neither character, so ghostty takes them from fallback fonts such as Noto Sans Mono, DejaVu Sans or Noto Sans Math. In a recording at font size 18 the fallback `▱` is wider than its cell, so neighbouring outlines overlap into `//`. The fallback `▰` is a solid shape with no outline, so filled slots do not look like filled-in empty slots. Jack sees it look wrong some runs and not others.

`fc-query` on `JetBrainsMonoNerdFont-Regular.ttf` lists which candidates the font has:

| characters | in the font |
|---|---|
| `▰` `▱` | no |
| `▮` `▯`, `▬` `▭`, `⬛` `⬜` | no |
| `■` `□` | yes |
| `█` `░` `▒` | yes |
| `━` `─` | yes |

## Open

- Which pair replaces `▰` and `▱`. Box-drawing and block characters such as `━` `─` and `█` `░` are drawn by ghostty itself rather than taken from a font, so they line up in any font. `■` `□` keep separate slots but come from the font.
close_reason: Landed in 47883db. The notes on this issue describe what changed.
